'''Kahiyuk''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Tarkov]] and his son, [[Jaccoba]], were [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] near Kahiyuk when they inadvertently came across a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|invasion]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] hidden in the [[Tree/Legends|forest]]. Retreating to Kahiyuk, the pair notified the nearby cities of [[Warralokk/Legends|Warralokk]], [[Grunnrurr/Legends|Grunnrurr]], and [[Rowrakruk/Legends|Rowrakruk]] of the Separatist presence. However, this did not prevent Kahiyuk from falling to the Separatist invaders.

==Description==
Kahiyuk was a [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and township located in the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]] on the<ref name="db" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> A large [[Tree/Legends|forest]] was located near Kahiyuk, as were the cities of [[Warralokk/Legends|Warralokk]], [[Grunnrurr/Legends|Grunnrurr]], and [[Rowrakruk/Legends|Rowrakruk]].<ref name="db" />

==History==
[[File:Tarkov_Sees_Sep_Army.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tarkov and Jaccoba find the Separatist army near Kahiyuk.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the last [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the Wookiee [[Parent/Legends|father]]-and-son pair [[Tarkov]] and [[Jaccoba]] were [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] in the forest near Kahiyuk. During their hunt, the Wookiees accidentally stumbled across a Separatist invasion [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|force]] hiding within the forest. The pair immediately rushed to Kahiyuk&mdash;the closest city to their position&mdash;to warn the residents of the advancing Separatist [[Army/Legends|army]]. The warning was soon spread to Warralokk, Grunnrurr, and Rowrakruk, but this did not stop the Separatists from conquering Kahiyuk and a number of other Wookiee cities before the natives could muster a defense.<ref name="db" /> The fall of these outposts caused the Wookiees to raise an army<ref name="rots">{{Film|III}}</ref> and notify the Republic of the Separatist presence on Kashyyyk in an attempt to [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|beat back]] the invaders.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kahiyuk was first briefly mentioned in Tarkov's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]] and was later mentioned in Tarkov's and Jaccoba's entries in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]].
